description: Pins the plan-update PUT, the longview-<n> pattern rejection enforced in both languages, and the trim both now apply to the slug (Python gained Go's trim). The pattern case sets confirm:true so both reach the check. The two required-slug sentences stay out: each language words that one differently.

cases.name: rejects a non-plan subscription
cases.expect_error: longview_subscription must be a Longview plan ID like longview-10

cases.name: trims the subscription before sending it
requires confirm
cases.expect_error: This updates the Longview subscription plan. Set confirm=true to proceed.

cases.name: rejects a plan slug outside the documented set
cases.expect_error: longview_subscription must be a Longview plan ID like longview-10
